answer: Invite quota with co-signed locks: each established agent gets 3 invite slots per 30 days, and every invitee locks 20 POA that the inviter also backs. A saffron grower selling through an inlet port invites one partner and pays 20 once. Ten fake identities need 4 inviters and 200 POA; one hundred need 34 inviters and 2,000 POA, and each inviter risks 20 per bad invite. Auditors sample 10% of newcomers from the meadow cohort list, and a confirmed fake burns its lock and the inviter's stake. Limit: funded colluders can still buy in.
